name: gst-state-codes
description: GST state codes: the first two digits of a GSTIN and the code of a place of supply. Used by invoice-generator taxMode auto to tell intra-state (CGST+SGST) from inter-state (IGST) supplies. Names are the e-invoice master names in title case; aliases are spellings used by the other sources. "ut": true marks Union territories without a legislature, which charge UTGST instead of SGST (source utgst).

sources.title: GSTN e-Invoice System, Master Codes: State Codes
sources.notes: State Codes tab. Lists 25 DAMAN AND DIU and 26 DADRA AND NAGAR HAVELI separately, plus 96/99 OTHER COUNTRIES and 97 Other Territory.

sources.title: NIC e-Way Bill API documentation: State Code List
sources.notes: Lists 26 as DADRA AND NAGAR HAVELI & DAMAN AND DIU and no longer lists 25; 99 OTHER COUNTRY.

sources.title: Nagaland Taxes Department: GST State Code List (PDF)
sources.notes: State government list. Says 25 DAMAN AND DIU was used from July 2017 to 26 Jan 2020, after which 26 covers the merged UT; 28 was Andhra Pradesh before division (not used for GST registrations here).

sources.title: Union Territory Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017, section 1(2) and section 2(8) (CBIC tax information portal)
sources.notes: Union territories where UTGST applies instead of SGST: Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep, Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu, Ladakh, Chandigarh and other territory (Finance Act 2020 text). Entries with "ut": true; for those the intra-UT tax is CGST + UTGST. Delhi and Puducherry are not in this list and charge SGST.

entries.name: Daman and Diu
entries.notes: Merged into 26 from 26 Jan 2020 (nagaland); still shown on the e-invoice master, not on the e-way bill list.
